title: The automatic detection of diabetic kidney disease from retinal vascular parameters combined with clinical variables using artificial intelligence in type-2 diabetes patients.
summary: In 515 retrospective patients with type 2 diabetes, a tuned random-forest model combining retinal vascular parameters and clinical variables detected diabetic kidney disease. This is a bounded diagnostic result and does not establish improved patient outcomes.
ai_technology: AI models combine retinal vascular parameters and clinical variables for DKD detection in 515 retrospective T2DM inpatients.
